actions.openSearchEngineRobots.label: Search engine robots
actions.openSearchEngineRobots.descripti: Open Settings to choose whether search engines may index a sales channel (default robots, noindex)
settingLabels.seo.default_robots.name: Default robots
settingLabels.seo.default_robots.descrip: What search engines are told about every page of the storefront, per sales channel. It only adds restrictions: a page that already says noindex stays noindex whatever is chosen here. NOINDEX asks search engines not to list the storefront, NOFOLLOW asks them not to follow its links. robots.txt is not changed, because a crawler has to fetch a page to read that it must not be indexed. A change is in force on the storefront within a few minutes; search engines apply it when they next visit a page, which can take days or weeks.
settingLabels.seo.robots_txt_custom.name: Custom robots.txt instructions
settingLabels.seo.robots_txt_custom.desc: Rules added to the storefront's robots.txt, per sales channel. The text is added after the rules the storefront generates itself, exactly as written here; those generated rules cannot be edited or removed. Leave it empty, or reset it, to serve the generated rules alone. robots.txt controls what crawlers may fetch, not what search engines list: forbidding crawling does not remove pages from search results, and a page that may not be fetched can still be listed from links elsewhere — to keep the storefront out of search results use "Default robots", and do not add "Disallow: /" on top of it, because a crawler that may not fetch a page never reads that it must not be indexed. At most 64 KiB of text. A change is in force on the storefront within a few minutes.
